title: HTML embedded photos not visible in Thunderbird for Android Version 18.0
creator: mopilu
content:
In Android Thunderbird version 18.0, embedded photos from my webcam are no longer immediately visible within the HTML email view and integrated into the message. Instead, they are now displayed as attachments. In all other clients, as well as in Thunderbird for Desktop, everything still works as expected. It also worked correctly in previous versions. With version 18.0, without any changes to the settings, this behavior has changed.

This is incredibly annoying and makes it practically unusable. Is there a solution, and is this recognized as a bug or intended as a security feature? If it is the latter, I kindly request that it be made configurable in the settings.

Moderator note: This question has been moved from the Firefox for Android forum.

title: Emails not syncing properly on Thunderbird for Android (IMAP issue?)
creator: seoguru262
content:
Hi everyone,

I recently set up my email on Thunderbird for Android to manage messages related to my website (https://vehiculoss.com ). The setup went smoothly, but I’m facing an issue where emails are not syncing consistently.

Sometimes new emails don’t appear unless I manually refresh, and occasionally sent emails take time to show up across devices. I’m using IMAP, so I expected real-time syncing between mobile and desktop.

Here’s what I’ve already tried:

Checked IMAP/SMTP settings (they seem correct) Disabled battery optimization for the app Ensured background data is enabled

Still, the issue persists. Could this be related to sync frequency settings, server delays, or something specific to the Android version of Thunderbird?

If anyone has faced something similar or has suggestions, I’d really appreciate the help.
